items.zh: 这就是共同经历的终点。
items.en: This is where the shared experience ends.

items.zh: 这些经历塑造了一个人的韧性和耐心。
items.en: The experiences forge an individual's resilience and patience.

items.zh: 她反对家长将AI用作父母的替代品。
items.en: She is against parents using Al as a substitute

items.zh: 对她来说恰到好处，正好可以解放自己。
items.en: The timing had been right for her to liberate herself.

items.zh: 这位工程师将心血倾注于芯片研发，不断地攻坚克难，赢得了“时代楷模”的美名。
items.en: All his efforts invested in the research and development chips, the engineer has consistently overcome tough challenges, earning the title of Role Model of the Times.
